results.claim: Every A9 packing can be normalized into an 1188×839 subrectangle of A0.
results.proof_sketch: Fix the orientations and labels of an arbitrary packing. Its feasible configuration space is compact, so minimize the sum of all x- and y-coordinates. At a minimizer, every sheet not touching the left boundary has a left blocker, since otherwise it could move slightly left; analogously, every sheet not touching the top boundary has a top blocker. Following left blockers strictly decreases x and ends at x=0, so every right edge is a nonnegative sum of 52 and 37. Following top blockers gives the same conclusion for every bottom edge. The largest representable value at most 1189 is 1188=20·52+4·37: 1189 is impossible because modulo 37 it would require the coefficient of 52 to be 25 modulo 37, already contributing more than 1189. The largest representable value at most 841 is 839=14·52+3·37; the corresponding congruence excludes 840 and 841. Thus the minimizing packing lies in [0,1188]×[0,839] and has integer coordinates.

results.claim: There is an explicit packing of 516 sheets.
results.proof_sketch: Write a placement as (x,y;w,h). Take (52i,37j;52,37) for 0≤i<20 and 0≤j<3, giving 60 sheets in [0,1040]×[0,111]. Take (1040+37i,52j;37,52) for 0≤i<4 and 0≤j<2, giving 8 sheets in [1040,1188]×[0,104]. Finally take (37i,111+52j;37,52) for 0≤i<32 and 0≤j<14, giving 448 sheets in [0,1184]×[111,839]. These three grids are contained in 1188×839 and are mutually interior-disjoint. Their cardinality is 60+8+448=516.

results.claim: No packing has 518 sheets; hence OPT≤517.
results.proof_sketch: On the normalized 1188×839 integer grid, give a unit cell weight 1/37 exactly when its lower-left coordinates satisfy x+y≡50 (mod 52), and weight zero otherwise. A 52×37 sheet contains one marked cell in each of its 37 rows. A 37×52 sheet contains one marked cell in each of its 37 columns. Thus either orientation has weight exactly 1. Since 1188=22·52+44 and 839=16·52+7, the marker count is 52·22·16+44·16+7·22=19162; there is no joint tail correction because r∈[0,43] and s∈[0,6] cannot satisfy r+s≡50 (mod 52). Hence the container weight is 19162/37=517+33/37<518. Nonoverlap makes the sum of sheet weights at most the container weight, so the integral packing cardinality is at most 517.

results.claim: Any hypothetical 517-packing must span a maximum reduced dimension and contain a prescribed blocking chain.
results.proof_sketch: Use the simultaneous left/top-stable representative from the normalization argument. Its occupied width and height are integers at most 1188 and 839. The sheets have total area 517·52·37=994708, while 1187·838=994706. Its bounding box therefore cannot have both width at most 1187 and height at most 838, so it reaches x=1188 or y=839. In the first case, follow left blockers from a sheet whose right edge is x=1188 to the boundary. The chain widths sum to 1188, whose unique nonnegative representation is 20·52+4·37. In the second case, a top-blocking chain has total height 839, whose unique composition is 3·37+14·52. These are necessary conditions only and do not exclude 517.

results.claim: The natural horizontal 111+728 decomposition is exactly capped at 516.
results.proof_sketch: Area bounds the 1188×111 band by 68 sheets, attained by the 60+8 construction. Consider a packing of N sheets in the 1188×728 band, and let n be the number oriented 52×37. Exact enumeration of nonnegative cross-section counts gives 5p+7q≤98 whenever 37p+52q≤728. Integrating over vertical lines yields 259N+n≤98·1188=116424. Similarly, 7p+5q≤160 whenever 52p+37q≤1188; integrating over horizontal lines yields 260N−n≤160·728=116480. Adding gives 519N≤232904<519·449, hence N≤448. A 32×14 grid of 37×52 sheets attains 448. Therefore packings respecting this fixed split contain at most, and can attain, 68+448=516; this does not constrain packings crossing the split.

results.claim: For a hypothetical 517-packing, exact row and column slack variables have nonnegative totals K=n−180 and L=341−n, respectively; consequently K+L=161.
results.proof_sketch: Normalize and let n be the number of 52×37 sheets. On unit row y let p_y and q_y count the 52-wide and 37-wide sheets, and put d_y=1188−52p_y−37q_y. The integer inequality 7p_y+5q_y≤160 follows from 37(7p_y+5q_y)=5(52p_y+37q_y)−p_y≤5940<37·161. Hence k_y=160−7p_y−5q_y≥0, and direct algebra gives p_y=20−5d_y+37k_y and q_y=4+7d_y−52k_y. Summing, using Σp_y=37n and Σq_y=52(517−n), gives K:=Σk_y=n−180. On unit column x, let a_x,b_x count the 37-high and 52-high sheets and e_x=839−37a_x−52b_x. Since 37(5a_x+7b_x)=5(37a_x+52b_x)−b_x≤4195<37·114, ℓ_x=113−5a_x−7b_x≥0. Algebra gives a_x=3+7e_x−52ℓ_x and b_x=14−5e_x+37ℓ_x. Summing gives L:=Σℓ_x=341−n. Thus K,L≥0 and K+L=161.

results.claim: The modulo-7 residue incidences force K+L≥245 for every hypothetical 517-packing, contradicting K+L=161; therefore 517 sheets cannot be packed.
results.proof_sketch: Let [z]₇ be the least nonnegative residue modulo 7 and put r=K mod 7. Partition the 839 rows by their indices modulo 52. Each 37×52 sheet meets each class once, so every class sum of q_y equals 517−n=337−K. From q_y=4+7d_y−52k_y, the sums of k_y in the seven classes of size 17 are congruent to 6−2K, and those in the other 45 classes of size 16 are congruent to 5K. Nonnegativity gives K≥R_r:=7[6−2r]₇+45[5r]₇. Likewise partition the 1188 columns modulo 52. Each 52×37 sheet meets each class once. From a_x=3+7e_x−52ℓ_x, the sums of ℓ_x in the 44 classes of size 23 are congruent to 5+2K, and those in the other eight classes of size 22 are congruent to 4+2K. Thus L≥C_r:=44[5+2r]₇+8[4+2r]₇. For r=0,1,…,6, the exact triples (R_r,C_r,R_r+C_r) are (42,252,294), (253,48,301), (149,96,245), (45,200,245), (305,304,609), (201,44,245), and (97,148,245). Hence K+L≥245, contradicting 161.

The explicit grids give OPT≥516. The residue-incidence contradiction excludes every 517-packing; any packing of at least 517 sheets would contain a 517-sheet subpacking, so OPT≤516. Therefore OPT=516.

final_writeup:
Let OPT denote the maximum number of orthogonally placed 52×37 A9 sheets in a 1189×841 A0 sheet. The exact value is

OPT = 516.

First normalize an arbitrary packing. For fixed labels and orientations, minimize the sum of all x- and y-coordinates over the compact feasible space. Every sheet not on the left or top boundary then has a blocker. Following blocker chains shows that every right and bottom edge is a nonnegative sum of 52 and 37, hence integral. The largest such sums within 1189 and 841 are 1188=20·52+4·37 and 839=14·52+3·37. It is therefore enough to use the 1188×839 integer-cell container.

The lower bound is explicit. Use (52i,37j;52,37) for 0≤i<20, 0≤j<3; (1040+37i,52j;37,52) for 0≤i<4, 0≤j<2; and (37i,111+52j;37,52) for 0≤i<32, 0≤j<14. These mutually disjoint grids contain 60+8+448=516 sheets.

For the upper bound, suppose that 517 sheets fit after normalization, and let n of them have orientation 52×37. For each unit row y, let p_y,q_y be the numbers of active sheets of widths 52,37. The cross-section inequality 7p_y+5q_y≤160 follows because

37(7p_y+5q_y)=5(52p_y+37q_y)−p_y≤5940<37·161.

Define d_y=1188−52p_y−37q_y and k_y=160−7p_y−5q_y. Then k_y is a nonnegative integer and

p_y=20−5d_y+37k_y,    q_y=4+7d_y−52k_y.

Summing over all 839 rows gives K:=Σk_y=n−180. Similarly, on each unit column x let a_x,b_x count active sheets of heights 37,52. The inequality 5a_x+7b_x≤113 follows from

37(5a_x+7b_x)=5(37a_x+52b_x)−b_x≤4195<37·114.

With e_x=839−37a_x−52b_x and ℓ_x=113−5a_x−7b_x,

a_x=3+7e_x−52ℓ_x,    b_x=14−5e_x+37ℓ_x,

and summing over all 1188 columns gives L:=Σℓ_x=341−n. Therefore K,L≥0 and K+L=161.

Now use the fact that a run of 52 consecutive integer rows or columns meets every residue class modulo 52 once. Let [z]₇ denote the least nonnegative residue modulo 7 and r=K mod 7. Among the 839 row indices modulo 52, seven classes have size 17 and 45 have size 16. Summing q_y in each class and reducing q_y=4+7d_y−52k_y modulo 7 forces

K ≥ R_r:=7[6−2r]₇+45[5r]₇.

Among the 1188 column indices, 44 classes have size 23 and eight have size 22. Summing a_x in each class and reducing a_x=3+7e_x−52ℓ_x modulo 7 forces

L ≥ C_r:=44[5+2r]₇+8[4+2r]₇.

For r=0,1,…,6, the seven values of R_r+C_r are respectively 294, 301, 245, 245, 609, 245, and 245. Thus K+L≥245, contradicting K+L=161. No 517-packing exists; a larger packing would contain a 517-sheet subpacking. Hence OPT≤516, and the explicit placement proves OPT=516.
